title: cmux NEXT customization samples
description: Small, live examples that connect cmux to the work already in your sessions.
install: Copy an example into its own folder, run cmux ext dev, then use the printed `cmux action run app.install --app <id>` hint and accept its install card once.
reload: Keep cmux ext dev running; each save reloads that example. Your existing customize app stays intact.

samples.title: My PRs
samples.description:
Keep your open pull requests beside your work.
Click a row to open it in a cmux browser tab.

samples.title: Needs you
samples.description:
See which agent chats are waiting for your answer.
Open the question directly from the sidebar.

samples.title: This workspace
samples.description:
Follow the tabs in your focused workspace.
Jump to its terminal, chat, or browser with one click.

samples.title: Dashboard links
samples.description:
Paste and keep the links your team uses every day.
Open a dashboard beside your code in a cmux browser tab.

samples.title: Branch status
samples.description:
See the branch and ahead/behind counts for the current chat.
Session Info follows that chat’s repository folder.

samples.title: Review requests
samples.description:
Keep the pull requests waiting for your review in the sidebar.
Open a review in a cmux browser tab.

samples.title: Working agents
samples.description:
See your working and blocked terminal agents together.
Click an agent to focus its terminal.

samples.title: Quick actions
samples.description:
Put useful cmux actions in your sidebar.
Each button runs a real app action from your click.

samples.title: Focus timer
samples.description:
Start or pause a short focus session beside your work.
Native controls count down and cmux tells you when time is up.

samples.title: Today
samples.description:
Keep a small Today list beside your workspace.
Add a note and keep it across reloads using local app storage.

apiGaps.note: github.pulls has no CI/check-run fields yet; add a signal before advertising CI badges.
New-agent actions do not accept a prompt or diff attachment yet.
cmux.status/1 validates, but NEXT does not render titlebar or chat-toolbar contributions.
workspaceCommand/workspace layout actions remain classic-only on NEXT.
Session Info has no per-chat token or cost signal.
cmux.live has no reactive parameters. Recreating readers inside dynamic scene children leaks subscriptions; use one render-scoped, event-driven loader until the SDK owns reader replacement.
cmuxConfig.* actions are restricted to local/customize; independently installed examples can invoke built-in actions only.
